<img src="profilepic.jpg" alt="Yanhe Eddie Lu" style="float: right; width: 200px; margin-left: 20px; border-radius: 5px;">

I am currently conducting research and preparing to apply for PhD programs for the Fall '26 admission cycle. I have graduated from [WashU Olin Business School](https://olin.wustl.edu) and [Central University of Finance and Economics](https://www.cufe.edu.cn), with training in analytics and economics.  

I'm broadly interested in how frictions and incentives shape micro-level decision-making. My research interests include corporate governance, financial contracting, M&A, real estate finance, political economics, and labor economics. I work with both empirical causal inferences and theoretical modeling.


This website hosts my brief introduction of experiences in [`vitae`](cv.qmd) section. You can also explore my [`repositories`](repo/index.qmd) with concise notes/cheatsheets, projects, and coding samples.
